first.rationale: Onboarding completion and activation are both declining, making a focused onboarding simplification test the most direct intervention for sustainable qualified revenue. Prior evidence supports both shorter onboarding and in-product activation messaging, but the archived records should be verified before committing. A small guarded test limits the risk of improving completion without improving meaningful activation or downstream revenue.

final.rationale: Run a controlled onboarding simplification experiment because onboarding completion is down 4% and the verified evidence shows shorter onboarding improved completion, reduced time-to-value by 2.1 days, and increased 30-day retention by 3%. Include activation messaging within the tested flow to address the simultaneous 6% activation decline, supported by verified evidence of an additional 6% activation lift and 1% retention lift. Evaluate not only completion, but meaningful activation, qualified pipeline or revenue, and 30-day retention so a superficial completion gain does not mask downstream value loss. Use a standard experiment this week with guardrails and preserve a control group.
